items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 36:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the palace of the Nukva? When the Nukva receives the Mochin from the head of ZA, and is found with him face to face, it is discerned that the Nukva is found in her own palace, in the palace of the Nukva, for there is her home. But with the Mochin of the back, which she receives from the Ima of the AB of the Mazal, by her ascent to Aba and Ima, then she is discerned as being in the authority of the groom, for the upper Aba and Ima are the aspect of the upper to ZA, and they are the authority of ZA and not of the Nukva, for the upper of the Nukva is ZA. See above, Answer 12. (Item 138).
